job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System
Proposals must be submitted on or before 5:00 p.m. Central Standard Time February 9, 2024
